title: Polish Aircrew 1943 Dunmoor Hill
memorial_details:
description: Blue-painted bronze plaque with a raised white border mounted on a wooden backboard, dedicated to the crew of a Wellington Bomber of 301 Pomeranian Squadron which crashed on Dunmoor Hill on 9th January 1943.  The dedication is in raised white Roman capitals on a pecked background.  Plaque and backboard are fixed at 45 degrees on top of a 1 metre post, which is supported at the base by a cairn of loose rocks.
This death is also recorded on the memorial to WW2 airmen killed on the Cheviot Hills (34297).
